_source: Phase 1 research synthesis, adversarially verified (71 claims survived, 14 killed). See heuristics.md for rationale and citations per class.

doc-other._repo_calibration: analogy to design-doc; no literature backing

py-stub._repo_calibration: analogy to py-src; no literature backing. Size is not the real concern for this class - it is a hand-maintained mirror of fathomdb-py/src/lib.rs, so it matters as a coupled surface.

ci-workflow._repo_calibration: no literature backing whatsoever. Google's 100-line shell trigger does not transfer to declarative CI YAML. Chosen to flag the three workflows that stand apart from the rest.
